_comment: Wind Master in-app feed (logo tap -> News / Supporters / Thanks). Two byte-identical copies exist, so this file reads the same in both: app/src/main/assets/news.json in the app repo is the offline seed shipped in the APK, and app/news.json in the WalvisAI/windmaster website repo is the live feed the app fetches every 6 h. To publish an update WITHOUT an app release, edit either copy, bump 'updated', copy it over the other one, and push the website repo. On the device 'updated' is compared as a plain string and the later one wins, with ties going to the cached remote copy — so ALWAYS bump it to something that sorts later than the copy already out there. A second edit on the same day must therefore add a time ('2026-08-10T15:16' sorts after '2026-08-10' and before '2026-08-11'); leaving the date alone makes the cached copy win the tie and the change never appears. A fetch that fails silently keeps whatever the app already had.
_newsNote: 'kind' is 'app' (a feature), 'hw' (a meter or other hardware) or 'partner'. 'logo' names a bundled drawable and is optional — see _supportersNote. 'link.url' may be a plain string or an {en,es} pair when each language has its own page. 'new': true draws a second NEW badge beside the kind. It is editorial, not derived from the date, and nothing on the device expires it — clear it by hand once the entry stops being the newest thing. Builds from before 2026-08-31 do not know the key and simply draw the entry without the badge, so publishing it ahead of a release costs nothing.

body.en: Integrated, switched on in the meter list, and taken out and tested on the field with exceptional results. An impeller for the speed and a magnetometer for the direction: point it down the lane once and the wind clock follows the wind on its own, while its temperature, humidity and pressure feed the solver. Pair it in Learn -> Field Practice.
body.es: Integrado, activo en la lista de medidores y probado en el campo con resultados excepcionales. Hélice para la velocidad y magnetómetro para la dirección: apúntalo una vez hacia el blanco y la esfera del reloj sigue al viento sola, mientras su temperatura, humedad y presión alimentan el cálculo. Empareja en Aprender -> Práctica de campo.

title.en: Wind Quiz: test your wind reading
title.es: Trivial: ponte a prueba con el viento

body.en: A new tile in LEARN. Ten questions a round, half of them computed for your own scope and profile, and some asked as pictures: read the mirage, judge the thread, or tap the reticle where your hold goes.
body.es: Una ficha nueva en APRENDER. Diez preguntas por ronda, la mitad calculadas con tu visor y tu perfil, y algunas planteadas con imágenes: lee el espejismo, juzga el hilo o toca la retícula donde va tu corrección.

title.es: Tabla de viento en marcas de retícula

body.en: Ballistic Calculator -> Wind Table can now give the hold in MDOTS, marks on the reticle of the scope you actually shoot, instead of centimetres or inches. Pick your optic and, on a second focal plane reticle, the magnification you will use.
body.es: Calculadora balística -> Tabla de viento ya puede dar la corrección en MDOTS, marcas de la retícula de la óptica con la que disparas, en lugar de centímetros o pulgadas. Elige tu visor y, si la retícula es de segundo plano focal, los aumentos que vas a usar.

title.en: Wind Observation: read the wind without firing a shot
title.es: Observación del viento: lee el viento sin disparar

body.en: A lane with the shooting taken out. The crosshair holds the full solution for you, so as the wind swings you see exactly where the reticle has to sit on the target — drift and elevation, live. Alongside it the Windicator lets you record your own thread's angle against measured wind speed, then use that table in the game instead of a generic curve.
body.es: Una calle sin disparo. La retícula mantiene sola la solución completa, así que cuando el viento cambia ves exactamente dónde debe quedar la cruz sobre el blanco: deriva y elevación, en vivo. Junto a ella, el Windicator te permite registrar el ángulo de tu propio hilo frente a la velocidad medida y usar esa tabla en el juego en lugar de una curva genérica.

title.en: Calypso Ultrasonic Portable Mini AB — planned
title.es: Calypso Ultrasonic Portable Mini AB — previsto

body.en: Ultrasonic, so there is nothing to spin: no cup, no impeller, no cut-in speed below which light wind reads as calm. It reports direction natively too. Support is planned and not yet started.
body.es: Ultrasónico, así que no hay nada que gire: sin cazoletas, sin hélice y sin velocidad mínima por debajo de la cual la brisa se lee como calma. También da la dirección de forma nativa. La compatibilidad está prevista y aún no empezada.

title.en: Field Practice with a live anemometer
title.es: Práctica de campo con anemómetro en vivo

body.en: Pair a Bluetooth weather meter and the simulator reads your real wind, temperature and pressure instead of generated values. Range estimation uses the target faceplate as the size reference, so you practise the whole call - not just the hold.
body.es: Empareja un medidor meteorológico Bluetooth y el simulador usará tu viento, temperatura y presión reales en lugar de valores generados. La estimación de distancia usa la cara del blanco como referencia de tamaño, así practicas la lectura completa, no sólo la corrección.

body.en: Cup anemometer with barometer, thermometer and hygrometer. Pair it in Learn -> Field Practice and the reticle shows a live point of impact from the wind actually blowing across you, with its atmosphere feeding the solver. Wind direction stays your own clock call — this meter has no vane.
body.es: Anemómetro de cazoletas con barómetro, termómetro e higrómetro. Empareja en Aprender -> Práctica de campo y la retícula muestra el punto de impacto en vivo con el viento que sopla realmente sobre ti, y su atmósfera alimenta el cálculo. La dirección la sigues cantando tú: este medidor no tiene veleta.

title.en: Training log: record your real sessions
title.es: Registro de entrenamiento: guarda tus sesiones reales

body.en: Learn -> Training keeps a lane-by-lane record of your actual shooting: hits, fails, notes and photos, with the day's conditions attached. Export the whole history (photos included) to a zip so it survives a new phone.
body.es: Aprender -> Entrenamiento guarda un registro calle por calle de tu tiro real: aciertos, fallos, notas y fotos, con las condiciones del día adjuntas. Exporta todo el historial (fotos incluidas) a un zip para que sobreviva a un cambio de móvil.

title.en: Wind Areas in the ballistic calculator
title.es: Zonas de viento en la calculadora balística

body.en: Real lanes rarely have one wind. Wind Areas splits the shot into zones with their own speed and direction and integrates the trajectory straight through them, so you can see what a sheltered first half really costs you downrange.
body.es: Las calles reales rara vez tienen un solo viento. Zonas de viento divide el disparo en tramos con su propia velocidad y dirección e integra la trayectoria a través de ellos, para que veas lo que realmente cuesta una primera mitad resguardada.

_supportersNote: A directory of logo tiles, grouped into categories and drawn three across. 'logo' names a drawable bundled in the app (res/drawable + res/raw/keep.xml). SHIP THE DRAWABLE FIRST: this feed reaches every installed version the moment it is pushed, but the PNG only reaches whoever updates, so naming a logo here before its build is live leaves everyone else looking at the supporter's initials on a blank white plate. That reads as broken, not as a graceful degrade — it happened to Armería Parriego on 2026-08-14. Add the drawable and its keep.xml entry, release the build, THEN push the feed. The initials fallback is there to keep the grid columns intact when a tile is genuinely missing, not to make early naming safe. Artwork should be at least 400px wide and ideally 600: the plate draws it around 96dp, so anything smaller is visibly soft on a modern phone. 'note' is an optional one-liner under the name — leave it out when the logo already says enough, and keep it to a few words or it clips. 'link.url' takes an {en,es} pair when the site has a separate page per language.
_collaboratorsNote: LEGACY — for installs older than the Supporters tab, which read 'collaborators' and know nothing about 'supporters'. Without this block those builds show an empty Collaborators tab the moment they fetch this feed. Current builds ignore it. Delete once the Supporters release has been out long enough that nobody is still on the old parser.

intro.en: Wind Master is shaped by the shooters who use it. Thank you to every beta tester who ran the early builds at the range, reported bugs and contributed many of the ideas that are now features — this app is better because of all of you. With special mention to:
